verdict.rationale: Evidence shows 'Ask Rippling' natural-language querying for devices/threats/compliance (rippling-it-docs-24) and general AI-driven automation, but there's no clear documentation of broad natural-language command interface for operating core IT functions (provisioning, access, device management) conversationally. missing for 10: comprehensive documentation of NL command coverage across IT workflows, independent/hands-on verification of the 'Ask Rippling' feature, and examples of natural-language commands actually executing actions beyond surfacing answers.
